specification.problem: Evaluate the balanced depth-2 NAND formula f(x)=NAND(NAND(x1,x2),NAND(x3,x4)) for explicit classical x in {0,1}^4 with a discrete-time quantum walk on a tree plus tail, with x compiled into gates. The abstract's O(sqrt N) claim for balanced formulas is the motivating goal; the general-formula bound is out of scope.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Only the N=4 balanced instance. Explicit x is compiled into gates, so no black-box query complexity is certified. The circuit is a fixed unitary walk on a small graph with a tail; the decode is a root-overlap threshold that must be calibrated over all 16 inputs by simulation. If the calibration fails, the circuit is only a walk-dynamics demo. The paper's actual construction is unknown and not reconstructed.

symbols.meaning: walk graph: tail vertex t, root r, internal vertices a,b, leaves l1..l4; leaf li is connected to its parent only if x_i=1 (to be calibrated)
edge-directed basis state: vertex v, direction d among its incident edge slots
flip-flop shift swapping |u,e\rangle with |v,e\rangle across edge (u,v)
degree-aware Grover coin on the deg(v) used slots of vertex v, identity (a -1 phase for a degree-1 vertex) on unused slots

symbols.domain: positive integer, chosen by calibration; O(sqrt N) is a heuristic

symbols.meaning: return probability to the tail edge state

equations.label: Formula
equations.description: Balanced depth-2 formula, with NAND(a,b)=not(a and b). The NAND of two NANDs equals the OR of the ANDs.
equations.justification: Boolean identity; the instance is a chosen smallest case.

equations.label: Walk step
equations.description: One step: the degree-aware coin at each vertex, then the flip-flop shift over edges present for x. Leaf edges present or absent depend on x, which is compiled into the gates.
equations.justification: Standard coined-walk form adapted from the sketch. It corrects the previous flawed global 2-qubit Grover coin. This is not the paper's exact walk.
assumptions: The x-dependent edge set is compiled classically
Absent leaf edges are modeled as a reflecting boundary (the leaf slot acts as a self-loop)

equations.label: Initial state
equations.description: The walker starts on the tail edge slot of the tail vertex that points toward the root, a valid used direction.
equations.justification: Fixes the invalid-slot problem in the earlier build: the start must be a used slot.
assumptions: Tail vertex t has one slot (0) toward the root

equations.label: Evolution
equations.description: State after T steps. T is calibrated, with O(sqrt N) steps as the heuristic.
equations.abstract_quote: O(√N) discrete query quantum algorithm for evaluating balanced binary NAND formulas
equations.justification: The abstract's sqrt(N) query bound suggests T=O(sqrt N) steps, each using one x-dependent operation.

equations.label: Decode statistic
equations.latex: p=|\langle t,0|\psi_T\rangle|^2,\quad \hat f=[p\ \text{on the side of }\theta\text{ matching the reflection regime}]
equations.description: Threshold on the return probability. By the sketch, reflection corresponds to f=1 and transmission to f=0, but the direction and threshold theta are to be validated over all 16 inputs. The sign convention is unverified.
equations.justification: From the sketch, not from the abstract. The runner must verify that the threshold separates the 16 inputs, otherwise report a demo only.
assumptions: Energy near zero is not guaranteed by this finite construction

registers.name: vertex
registers.role: vertex index 0..7: 0 tail, 1 root, 2-3 internal, 4-7 leaves

registers.name: slot
registers.role: edge slot at the vertex: 0 parent/tail direction, 1-2 child directions; slot 3 unused

specification.initial_state: |t,0> with vertex=0 and slot=0, prepared explicitly (this is the used tail slot). Qubit ordering is little-endian, slot low bits then vertex.

steps.description: Prepare |t,0> explicitly, with the tail vertex's single slot pointing to the root.
Apply the degree-aware coin at every vertex and the flip-flop shift over the x-dependent edge set. Leaf slots with absent edges reflect.
Repeat for T steps, with T calibrated against all 16 inputs.
Offline, compute p and compare it to the threshold to decode f(x). This is outside the unitary.

specification.measurement: None inside the unitary. For decoding, measure or compute the probability of |t,0>. No output ancilla is built.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Threshold p at a calibrated theta to output f(x). If no theta separates all 16 inputs, disclose that the circuit is only a walk-dynamics demo.
assumptions: Scope is limited to depth-2 balanced N=4
x is compiled into gates, so no black-box query claim
The edge conventions, the reflecting leaf boundary and T are free choices that need calibration
missing_information: The paper's exact walk, weights and phase-estimation procedure
The rebalancing procedure for arbitrary formulas
